description: sing-box 的 Windows 图形客户端（机器级安装，含系统服务） | Windows GUI client for sing-box, installed machine-wide with the daemon service
notes_cn: 脚本化机器级安装：解包官方安装器里的 app-64.7z 到 C:\Program Files\sing-box，并注册 sing-box-daemon 服务；安装、更新、卸载都需要管理员权限，请在提权终端里执行 scoop 命令
不运行官方安装器——该安装器在部分 Windows 版本上会因预检异常直接退出（代码 30），所以这里只取它的应用载荷
服务以 LocalSystem 运行、自动启动，TUN 模式不再需要每次提权
GUI 数据在 C:\ProgramData\sing-box，服务数据在 C:\ProgramData\sing-box-daemon；卸载会保留数据
不能与官方安装器版同时存在：同一安装路径、同一服务名 sing-box-daemon
notes: Scripted machine-wide install: unpacks app-64.7z from the official installer into C:\Program Files\sing-box and registers the sing-box-daemon service; install, update and uninstall all require administrator rights, so run scoop from an elevated terminal
The official installer is never executed — it aborts with code 30 on some Windows builds because of a preflight failure — only its application payload is used
The service runs as LocalSystem with automatic start, so TUN mode no longer needs elevation each time
GUI data lives in C:\ProgramData\sing-box and service data in C:\ProgramData\sing-box-daemon; uninstall keeps the data
Cannot coexist with an installer-based copy: same installation path and same sing-box-daemon service name
pre_install: $daemon = "$env:ProgramFiles\\sing-box\\resources\\daemon\\sing-box-daemon.exe"; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $daemon) { & $daemon service stop 2>&1 | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; Get-Process -Name 'sing-box' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800; $payload = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Recurse -Filter 'app-64.7z' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$payload) { error 'app-64.7z not found in the installer payload'; A-Show-IssueCreationPrompt; A-Exit }; $target = "$env:ProgramFiles\sing-box"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $target -Force | Out-Null; Expand-7zipArchive -Path $payload.FullName -DestinationPath $target -Removal:$false
post_install: $daemon = "$env:ProgramFiles\sing-box\resources\daemon\sing-box-daemon.exe"; & $daemon service install --working-directory "$env:ProgramData\sing-box-daemon"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { error "sing-box-daemon service install failed ($LASTEXITCODE)"; A-Show-IssueCreationPrompt; A-Exit }; $key = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\SagerNet\sing-box'; New-Item -Path $key -Force | Out-Null; New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'LayoutVersion' -Value 2 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null; New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'InstallationID' -Value ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('B')) -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null; New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'ApplicationDataDirectory' -Value "$env:ProgramData\sing-box" -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null; New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'DaemonDataDirectory' -Value "$env:ProgramData\sing-box-daemon" -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null; $lnk = "$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\sing-box.lnk"; $ws = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $sc = $ws.CreateShortcut($lnk); $sc.TargetPath = "$env:ProgramFiles\sing-box\sing-box.exe"; $sc.IconLocation = "$env:ProgramFiles\sing-box\sing-box.exe"; $sc.WorkingDirectory = "$env:ProgramFiles\sing-box"; $sc.Save()
pre_uninstall: $daemon = "$env:ProgramFiles\sing-box\resources\daemon\sing-box-daemon.exe"; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $daemon) { & $daemon service uninstall 2>&1 | Out-Null }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath "$env:ProgramFiles\sing-box" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -LiteralPath "$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\sing-box.lnk" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\SagerNet\sing-box' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
